advancements.strata_epochs.root.title: Strata: Deep Time
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_drill: Right-click the ground to drill a core sample. It shows which epoch lies beneath this region (8×8 chunks).
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_sample: Shows an epoch. Right-click an Epoch Gate with it to travel there. The sample is used up.
jei.strata_bridge.info.epoch_gate: Right-click with a core sample to enter its epoch. Inside an epoch, right-click the gate to return. Gates inside epochs cannot be broken.
jei.strata_bridge.info.time_anchor: Keep it in your inventory to double the time you can stay in an epoch before you solidify.
jei.strata_bridge.info.petrified_stone: Forms around players who stay too long in an epoch.
jade.strata_bridge.gate.enter: Right-click with a core sample to travel
